title: Control rows
summary: Canonical label-plus-control row builders returning {el, set}: sliderRow (with number box, optional log scale), selectRow, checkRow, toggleRow, colorRow, numberRow, matrixRow, curveRow. Build once, patch with set(). Canonical home for the six colour-row twins.
description: Each builder creates its DOM once and returns `Row<T> = { el, set(v) }`; `set` patches only when the value differs and does not overwrite a focused field. Handlers are `onInput`/`onChange` callbacks. Canonical home for the six colour-row twins (B06 line 108): `colorRow` here replaces the local colour or colour-spelled row builders found in stroke-path-dialog, content-fill-dialog, app-dialogs, page-prefs, artboard-dialog and the filter panel swatchRow; a port should import these instead of writing another. Other local re-definitions exist (properties.ts `sliderRow`, lens-batch-dialog and depth-limit). Imports `clamp` from the engine and `curveValue` from a distort filter for `curveRow`; a port drops or replaces `curveRow`/`matrixRow` if it has no such engine.
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

exports.signature: export interface Row<T> { el: HTMLElement; set(v: T): void }
exports.doc: What every row builder returns: the element to mount and set(v) to patch its value in place.
Formats a number to at most three decimals without trailing zeros.

exports.signature: export function sliderRow(label: string, min: number, max: number, step: number, onInput: (v: number) => void, limits: { min?: number; max?: number; def?: number; log?: boolean } = {}): Row<number>
exports.doc: Range input plus number box; limits.min and max clamp the box, limits.def is restored on double-click of the label or track, limits.log maps the track logarithmically (min above 0).

exports.signature: export function selectRow(label: string, options: ReadonlyArray<readonly [string, string]>, onChange: (v: string) => void, onHover?: (v: string | null) => void): Row<string>
exports.doc: With `onHover`, the choices show as the hover-preview menu: the value under the pointer or arrow keys, null when it closes.

exports.signature: export function checkRow(label: string, onChange: (v: boolean) => void): Row<boolean>
exports.doc: Label with a checkbox; onChange gets the boolean.

exports.signature: export function toggleRow(label: string, onChange: (v: boolean) => void): Row<boolean>
exports.doc: Label with a switch-style toggle (cv-toggle) over a checkbox; onChange gets the boolean.
Wraps an existing checkbox input in the cv-toggle switch markup.

exports.signature: export function colorRow(label: string, onChange: (hex: string) => void): Row<string>
exports.doc: Label with a colour input; onChange gets a #rrggbb string and set() patches it without disturbing a focused field.

exports.signature: export function matrixRow(label: string, size: number, min: number, max: number, onInput: (v: number[]) => void): Row<number[]>
exports.doc: A size by size grid of number fields; onInput gets the flat array.

exports.signature: export function curveRow(label: string, min: number, max: number, onInput: (v: number[]) => void): Row<number[]>
exports.doc: A curve box for flat pairs of position (0 to 1, down the box) and value (min to max, across it). Drag a point, click the box to add one, double-click or Delete to remove one; the end points keep their positions. The nodes are built once.

exports.signature: export function numberRow(label: string, min: number, max: number, step: number, onChange: (v: number) => void): Row<number> & { input: HTMLInputElement }
exports.doc: Label with a number input; also exposes the input element for extra wiring.

invariants.text: Build a node once, then patch text, classes, hidden flags and lists in place. Never assign innerHTML or clear textContent on a live container to rebuild it, and reserve space so nothing shifts when content arrives.
User-visible strings go through t() from the i18n module; the English text is the key.

Every colour, space and radius comes from a token in the studio-dark token set (var(--bg-*), var(--text-*), var(--border-*), var(--space-*), var(--radius-*)); no literal colour values in component code.
Use these builders; do not define another sliderRow, colorRow or colourRow in a feature file.
Range and number inputs carry aria-label from the row label.

examples.title: Colour row with a hex handler
examples.snippet: this.colorRowEl = colorRow('Color', (hex) => { this.color = { r: parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16), g: parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16), b: parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16) }; });
examples.whenToUse: A colour picker row in a dialog; convert hex to your colour type in the handler.

examples.title: Colour row feeding a setting
examples.snippet: const vigColor = colorRow('Vignette color', (hex) => { (D().vignette ??= defaultVignetteShape()).color = hex; this.schedule(); });
examples.whenToUse: A colour row wired straight to settings and a re-render schedule.
